request.current_synthesis: Established by the scientific model: the official targets are reachable, the system is deterministic and disturbance-free, and complete success requires braking and maintaining low Cartesian error for 100 consecutive control samples. Manipulability deteriorates near folded and extended configurations, making correction sensitivity geometry-dependent. The current training environment samples only 0.14-0.20 m, so an official-distribution failure could be caused primarily by missing inner-workspace experience. A competing explanation is a controller or learning-signal limitation: even on trained radii, nonzero joint velocity, 20 ms action holding, or reward emphasis on entry may produce late exits. No policy has been trained or measured in this campaign, so neither explanation is established and no intervention should yet be treated as causal.
request.decision_frontier: After the first policy evidence, determine whether failures are concentrated in the unseen inner-radius region or occur across trained radii as high-entry, low-hold, overshoot, or late-exit behavior. request.human_goal_connection: The human goal requires at least 98% complete, uninterrupted 2-second holds over the official 0.06-0.20 m full-angle target distribution.
